product_one_liner.value: Abacus.AI is an AI assistant and agent platform for professionals, teams and enterprises that combines leading AI models to build applications, create content and automate business workflows.

pricing_page.notes: Public billing documentation lists Basic and Pro subscription plans and prices.

named_customers.notes: Named customer case studies; these establish customer relationships, not necessarily current contracts.

employee_band.notes: Based on the reported headcount of 288; a separate September 2026 profile reports 278. The profile also retains a broader, inconsistent company-size label.

eng_blog.notes: Two technical posts explain model training, quantization and deployment: Smaug-Decisions (November 2, 2026), coauthored by CTO Arvind Sundararajan, and Smaug-Humanizer (October 26, 2026), by ML engineer Lokesh Reddy.

ai_ml_roles_open.notes: The live careers page lists Research Scientist and Software Engineer - Generative AI.

model_provider.value: OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, xAI, Meta, DeepSeek and Qwen; Abacus.AI also provides its own Smaug models.

compliance_certs.notes: Company-stated standards and compliance claims, not independently verified certificates. The security page says its program aligns with SOC 2 Type II, ISO/IEC 27001, HIPAA and GDPR; its security paper claims PCI DSS 3.2.1 compliance.

raised_18mo.notes: The latest reported round is October 27, 2021, before the May 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 window.

hiring_sdr_ae.notes: The live careers page lists Junior Sales Development Representative (Jr SDR).

launched_6mo.notes: Smaug-Decisions launched November 2, 2026, and Smaug-Humanizer launched October 26, 2026, within May 9–November 9, 2026.

leadership_change_12mo.notes: No external C-level or VP join or departure in November 9, 2025–November 9, 2026 could be verified. Christopher Yates and Thodoris Petropoulos started VP roles in March and February 2026, respectively, but both profiles show prior Abacus.AI employment, establishing internal promotions rather than company joins. The broader leadership roster lacks complete dated histories, so absence cannot be established.

crm_stack_signal.notes: Outreach and Salesloft are named prospecting tools in the SDR posting; HubSpot and Salesforce are documented product integrations, not proof of internal CRM adoption.
